reasons: Status is correctly characterised as a missing behaviour: Section 9 contains only for-cause, insolvency and security/SLA/law/IP termination rights, and Section 8.1's three-year term plus the Section 2.1 take-or-pay 'without reduction or termination rights' language put the contract in the playbook's walk-away zone (no Customer no-fault exit in a multi-year term).

The redline reaches the preferred position with substantially the model language: Customer convenience termination on 30 days' written notice, refund of prepaid Fees for the post-termination period, express bar on early-termination fees/penalties, and confirmation that Vendor has no convenience exit during the then-current term.

The Section 2.1 conforming edit is justified and narrowly targeted: it removes only the 'without reduction or termination rights' carve-out that would otherwise negate the new right, leaving the volume commitment intact, so the 0.667 changed-character ratio is acceptable for this short clause rather than evidence of over-editing.
Comment is accurate, in-voice and correctly cites the playbook position while offering the 60-90 day / three-month fee-cap fallback.

Drafting nit (not disqualifying): the inserted convenience paragraph is appended to Section 9.3 without a number, yet Section 2.1 now cross-references 'Section 9.4'. Label the new paragraph '9.4' (the numbering gap between 9.3 and 9.5 accommodates it) so the cross-reference resolves.
